description: Phlo Transform job metadata that has no standard OpenLineage equivalent.

uri.description: The model:// URI — the job's logical identity in Phlo.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the model's SQL file.

materialization.description: How the model is materialized: view|table|incremental|ephemeral.

workflow.description: The owning workflow root, when the model belongs to one.

version.description: The content-addressed desired version of the model.
